item.title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Gets the Furby Treatment With New Furblets Collection
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest trends and must-have items. Today, we're talking about the merchandising phenomenon that's taken over the world: KPop Demon Hunters. If you're a fan of the Netflix series, you'll love the latest addition to the merchandise lineup: officially licensed Furby Furblets from Hasbro."
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: "For those who may not know, Furby first debuted in 1998 and became a huge hit. And now, they're back in a big way, with a new generation of collectors and fans on TikTok. The Furblets are miniature versions of the classic Furby, offering the same interactive features and playful sounds in a pocket-sized design."
[Sound effects: A quick clip of a Furby's signature chatter]
Host: "Hasbro's new collection features two adorable characters from KPop Demon Hunters: the Saja Boy Demon and the fan-favorite Derpy Tiger. Each Furblet stands three inches tall, has over 45 sounds, and comes with a removable hat and keychain clip. You can even pair them up to create a harmonizing duo."
[Soft music continues]
Host: "These collectible mini-plush toys are available now on Amazon and Walmart for $14.97 each. And if you're looking for something even more special, check out the Limited-Edition Furby Galaxy Edition, an Amazon exclusive that features a glow-in-the-dark design and stands over six inches tall."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. If you're a fan of KPop Demon Hunters or just love collecting fun and interactive toys, be sure to check out the new Furby Furblets collection. Until next time, stay tuned for more exciting updates and trends."
